notes.title: Patch 1.6 ( Nintendo Switch equivalent)
notes.notes:
PATCH 1.6

I am very happy to announce Patch 1.6 is released, this version is exactly the same as coming Nintendo Switch release in coming weeks.

[list]
[*] It is free of major bugs.
[*] Speed and Difficulty balanced.
[*] China is now present ( Taiwan removed )
[*] Pass and Shoot response faster.
[/list]

Wait for your feedback, as always.
Ruben

notes.title: Patch 1.3 ready! ( Keyboard support and more )
notes.notes:
Hi Footballers,

Right now you can play [b]Super Arcade Soccer [/b]using your [b]Keyboard and Mouse[/b], I wrote Steam support to remove text in the description about [strike]Game Controller Required[/strike].

Also added a new GK mechanic to let player [b]Drop Kick[/b] to avoid problems like hand pass issues.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34482863/ebab613496a219f3db1741f8c5192db1c46fbc9a.gif[/img]

I keep working in all you told me seems wrong in the game, I only need time to fix it, thanks so much for your support, special thanks this time to @Ryan

notes.title: Patch 1.2 available now ( MacOS next monday )
notes.notes:
Ok guys, the game [b]now has changed[/b] sustantially in order to fix the issues lof of people told me here.

Mainly you will experience:

[list]
[*] Game Speed increased almost 2X, so game now is more similar to Sensible Soccer or Kick-Off

[*] Change Player button, I think it is not perfect solution, but sure It is very close to be.

[*] AI is now awesome in my opinion, you will feel the huge diference.

[*] Input compatibility improved, the game should be accepting more game controllers.
[/list]

This is the first step to make Super Arcade Soccer better and better, thank to you all for feedback, especially to @TiagoSousa77

Enjoy!

notes.title: TIP: After Touch
notes.notes:
Some users don't know that they can shoot with after-touch, just change direction after shooting and ball direction will be bend, so your shoots could be more accurated. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34482863/7b9920f13a038da2ed25bc37a99e7fb3b897857c.png[/img]

notes.title: Very deep changes in gameplay
notes.notes:
Hi there, 

Unfortunatelly,  [b]Super Arcade Soccer[/b] is not working as expected on sales.
Too many negative reviews received but with many good recomendations in order to improve the match. That is why,  I decided to get my hands to work on it!

Coming PATCH 1.2 is on track  ( maybe tomorrow ) including a fully improved AI in order to show you guys how the game is progressing now.
The next video is gonna show you a game played by AI vs AI to see now progress.

[url=https://youtu.be/SZTYC6YtnbU]AI vs AI[/url]

Hope you like guys and could give another chance to this game.

Sincerely,
Ruben
